preconditions.description: The number of records n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and abs(x) <= 10**9 for x in operations)
preconditions.description: All numbers in the operations must be integers not exceeding 10^9 by their absolute value.

preconditions.expression: all(op in {'insert', 'getMin', 'removeMin'} for op in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation must be one of 'insert', 'getMin', or 'removeMin'.

postconditions.description: The number of records in the modified sequence must be at least as many as the original records.

postconditions.expression: all(op in {'insert', 'getMin', 'removeMin'} for op in corrected_operations)
postconditions.description: All operations in the corrected sequence must be valid.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and abs(x) <= 10**9 for x in corrected_operations)
postconditions.description: All numbers in the corrected operations must be integers not exceeding 10^9 by their absolute value.
